name: Goblin Lookout
desc: The goblin lookout knows where the hidden lever sits, bargains if cornered, and delays intruders until reinforcements arrive.

title: Copper Vault Entrance
text: Torchlight spills across damp stone and rusted iron gates while anxious guards whisper about missing cargo and unpaid debts.

heading: Stolen Key Rumor
content: A stolen key can open a smugglers tunnel beneath the city. Rival crews are already searching for it, and every hour raises the stakes.

body: The hidden tunnel is narrow, slick with condensation, and designed for fast escapes rather than fair fights.

name: Captain Sera Vale
text: Captain Sera Vale wants the missing key recovered quietly before the city watch loses face. She rewards practical results and distrusts grand speeches.
